## Type

- [ ] Bug fix

## Checklist

- [ ] `mvn -B clean verify` passes locally (or `bash scripts/verify-all.sh`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the behaviour change
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, README, ADR when architecture changes)
- [ ] New files carry `// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0` (Java) or an equivalent license header
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or wallet material in the diff
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO — see CONTRIBUTING.md)
